Configuration

This version of the text assumes you are using Rust 1.90.0 or later with edition = "2024" in the Cargo.toml file of all projects to configure them to use Rust 2024 Edition idioms.

The HTML format is available online at the official site and offline with installations of Rust made with rustup; run rustup doc --book to open it in a browser.

See the Installation section of Chapter 1 for instructions on installing or updating Rust, and see Appendix E for information on editions.
